what: Halliburton provides services to oil and gas companies: drilling fluids, directional drilling, well cementing, and above all hydraulic fracturing, where it is the largest provider in North America.
customers: Oil and gas producers worldwide, with North American shale and Middle Eastern national oil companies the largest markets.
money: fracturing, cementing, completion tools and chemicals
drilling fluids, directional drilling and wireline
moat: Equipment fleets and field crews at a scale few can match, with technology in fracturing and drilling that improves well productivity measurably.
risks: North American fracturing activity has fallen and pricing is weak
Producers are drilling fewer, more efficient wells, which reduces service intensity
opportunities: Analysts see about 36% upside from current levels
International and Middle Eastern work has been growing while North America has not
Electric fracturing fleets command premium pricing and lower fuel costs
watch: North American pressure pumping pricing and international revenue growth.
